text:
tess_sales: Quick thread — CobaltGate wants to kick off a 2-week POC but their security team tightened identity requirements (SSO, SCIM, strict RBAC + domain locking). Need a fast preflight.

ria_se: I can take this. Key asks?

tess_sales: They need SAML (IdP + SP initiated), SCIM v2 with delta and bulk import, explicit role assignment via SCIM payload (they want role attribute on Group -> map to tenant role), delegated tenant admins, domain-locked provisioning, and SIEM forwarding for audit logs during the POC.

omar_sec: Questionnaire flags: BYOK required (customer-managed keys), HSM/FIPS attestation mention, immutable audit trail, and longer retention options (180/365 days). Also they want evidence of key rotation processes.

haley_pm: Product notes: POC on dedicated nodes OK. Default audit retention 90d; enterprise retention (180/365) available as an opt-in. SIEM forwarding supported via webhook or syslog. File-upload domain verification can be supported for POC via support ticket.

ria_se: SCIM details: we support Users and Groups, delta via ChangeLog. Rate limits for enterprise POC: 1k ops/min; for >25k users recommend bulk import job (async). Important: our RBAC engine does not yet auto-map a "role" attribute from the SCIM Group payload into tenant roles — current product requires admin-API mapping.

ria_se: Workaround for POC: small lambda that watches SCIM changes and hits admin role-mapping API. Example snippet: 

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/role-mappings 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"group":"okta:cobalt-admins","role":"tenant_admin"}'

frank_billing: For credits we can cover up to 220k tokens/day for a 2-week POC. Anything above needs a short paid uplift or small commit. I can prepare a one-page SOW and trial terms.

om ar_sec: (typo) — also add: for BYOK we integrate with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault; keys are non-exportable. For HSM/FIPS requests we can provide attestation docs; rotation can be scheduled via customer KMS rotation policies.

idp_bot: sso_scan: metadata check for cobaltgate-idp passed (scan 1796543500) :white_check_mark:

haley_pm: Action items: Ria -> SCIM/SSO runbook + mapping lambda example; Frank -> SOW/credits; Omar -> security questionnaire answers + attestation docs; I'll create the preflight invite and consolidate.

tess_sales: I'll ask CobaltGate to upload verification file to support ticket and confirm expected user count (approx 18k) and peak tokens/day. Scheduling preflight for tomorrow 11am PT.

frank_billing: I'll share the SOW by EOD and note overage path.

ria_se: I'll include explicit notes on chunking for bulk import and sample payloads.

om ar_sec: (typo again) — will gather the HSM attestation pack and add KMS integration notes for the questionnaire.

haley_pm: :thumbsup: Keeping this short — post runbook when ready and I'll share the invite.
